name: Full-width table with wrapping text
description: A table stretched to `\textwidth` where the `X` column wraps long text automatically.
notes: `X` columns share whatever width is left after the other columns.
`>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X` gives ragged-right text, which reads better than justified text in narrow cells.
Don't use `\verb` inside `tabularx`. It reads the whole body as an argument, so `\verb` breaks.
